Build your dataset

JSON: {"students":[{"student_id":"S001","courses":["CS201","MA201"]}]}. Optional course metadata: "courses":[{"id":"CS201","name":"Data Structures"}]. Import replaces the current dataset. Maximum 120 courses and 5,000 students in this browser app.

Reproducible registrations with cohort-biased course selection. Use the same seed to repeat your experiment.

The generator favors groups of 8 courses with occasional cross-cohort choices. More shared registrations create denser conflict graphs and can require more slots.
MAKE IT FIT YOUR WEEK

Calendar settings

Slots start at 09:00, 12:00, 15:00 and 18:00, in campus local time. Calendar exports use floating local time.

The gap optimizer reorders whole slots while preserving a proper coloring. It improves a soft objective; it does not guarantee the best possible spacing.
